notes: Shot list for the shapeof.world site trailer. Record with films/site-trailer/tools/capture.mjs (see header for schema). Coordinates <=1 are viewport fractions. Defaults: 1920x1080, 60fps, step mode, query capture=1&ghost=0. 'priority' 1 = must-have hero, 2 = strong montage, 3 = filler/variety. Steps were written from the live-site control inventory (media root inventory.json) and smoke-tested at preview quality; recorders should look at each contact sheet and tune framing/timing.

shots.note: Scrubbing .gcx-time snaps the camera to a far wide view and the galaxies stay apart (probed 400-900): do NOT scrub. Let it play at 2x from load; tune the wait so the record lands on the tidal-tail moment. Tested: at ~20s wait the merger is happening but small/dim in frame; added a wheel zoom-in — verify scale, or crop with ss:2. After zoom (tested): merger reads as a dim star cloud, not yet premium — try the 俯视 camera, a longer/shorter wait, or demote.
